summary: Bind science-pack manufacturing to productive item outputs.
details: The existing dynamic science-pack stream now requires a productive item output for each base or discovered lab science item and rejects explicit upstream productivity bans. Same-named fluid producers and excluded science items with unrelated coproducts cannot inherit that item bonus.

Explicit group and stream output constraints remain authoritative, including empty or false constraints. Existing research identities, modifiers, startup settings and science ownership are preserved; no second Angel sample owner is introduced.

The controlled route fixture executes canonical discovery, recipe normalization and matching on F210 and F200. Current-package catalogue, output, migration and native Angel sample/garden/seed acceptance remain pending.
